title: perf: read the merged headers once in the trust proxy getters
prompt:
> **Context:** Sibling to #7018 (which stopped validation from reading request parts when no validator exists). This addresses the trust proxy host and protocol getters in lib/request.js (request.js:120-148), which still read the copying request.headers getter twice per access.

the trust proxy request class defines its own host and protocol getters that honor x-forwarded-host and x-forwarded-proto when the proxy is trusted. the host getter reads this.headers twice per access, once for the x-forwarded-host check and once for the host fallback, and the protocol getter pays the same price on its x-forwarded-proto branch. every read of the request.headers getter copies the full merged header set when request.headers was assigned in a hook (onRequest, preParsing, a content-type parser or preValidation, same list #7018 documented)

so with a hook like

```js
fastify.addHook('onRequest', (request, reply, done) => {
  request.headers = { ...request.headers, 'x-request-id': id }
  done()
})
```

one request.host access copied all headers twice, request.hostname inherits it through this.host and request.protocol pays the same price on its own branch. #7018 already fixed the validation side of this, this PR applies the same rule to the getters themselves: read this.headers once and reuse that object, so an access copies the merged headers at most once

the returned values are unchanged in every case, this is a pure allocation reduction, no default or precedence moves. the regular (non trust proxy) host getter already reads raw.headers directly and needs no change

testing proof:

- new tests in test/internals/request.test.js count the reads of the merged headers getter through an own accessor on the request and assert one copy per access, one test for the host getter and one for the protocol getter: each fails on main with 2 !== 1 and passes with the fix (16/16 in that file)
- a live probe on untouched main shows one request.host read copies the merged headers twice, once with the fix, values identical in both cases
- adjacent internals stay green: test/internals/handle-request.test.js + test/internals/request-validate.test.js → 51/51
- full `npm run unit` 2343 tests, 0 failures, `npm run test:types` 1282 assertions pass, `npx eslint lib/request.js test/internals/request.test.js` clean
- one commit, Signed-off-by present (DCO)

This change was developed with AI assistance. The analysis, reproduction, red/green test evidence, and final diff were reviewed by the branch author before opening this pull request.
